name: Ricardo Mendoza
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the roaring engines at local rally races. He honed his craft through rigorous training at the Instituto Tecnológico de Buenos Aires, specializing in advanced composite materials. He quickly found his niche, becoming known for his meticulous attention to detail and ability to repair complex aerodynamic components under immense pressure.

He started out in smaller Argentine racing teams, eventually attracting the attention of Prema Junior. Ricardo is particularly adept at diagnosing subtle structural weaknesses and finding innovative solutions to improve the durability of composite parts. He is known for his exacting standards, ensuring that every component is race-ready and performs flawlessly. He is a cornerstone of Prema Junior's success.

Despite his demanding nature, Ricardo is respected for his expertise and unwavering commitment to excellence. He believes that success is built on precision and a relentless pursuit of perfection, a philosophy he instills in his team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is a stocky man with strong hands and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always calibrates his tools precisely before each use, regardless of time constraints.
Keeps a small vial of mate tea on his workbench, sipping it throughout the day.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on surfaces when deep in thought, often disrupting others.
